ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 65 / OppVR85] Reason Lost and Lost Comments are required when moving to Stage = Lost. Approved by IRM, no change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lost'),
ISCHANGED(StageName),
OR( ISPICKVAL(IM_Reason_Lost__c, ''), ISBLANK(IM_Lost_Comments__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Reason Lost and Lost Comments are required. Please enter values for both fields.
